reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
5키로 말티즈 흉통이 큰편이고 다리가 길쭉 길쭉한 아이입니다! 

사이즈는 상의는 L / 모자는 M 사이즈 구매했는데 딱 잘 맞습니다!! 

디자인 너무 귀엽고, 통기서 너무 좋고, 신축성도 쫜쫜하고 아주 좋습니다.

포차코 콜라보라고 해서 콜라보 전제품 구매해 버렸습니다 ... !

귀여운거옆에 귀여운거라니 이보다 좋은수가 없네요~~완전 베리굿 입니다요!!

5.6kg 둘찌 고양이에겐 좀 타이트 합니다!
물론 첫찌 멈뭉이가 입을거지만 제질이 좋아 고양이도 함께 입혀 보았습니다 ㅋㅋㅋ
reviews.content_en: My 5kg Maltese has a broad chest and long, skinny legs! I got size L for the top and size M for the hat, and they fit perfectly!! The design is so cute, the breathability is great, and the stretch is perfect. It's super good. I heard it was a Pochacco collab so I ended up buying all the collab products...! Cuteness next to cuteness - can't get better than this~~ Totally awesome!! For my 5.6kg chubby cat it's a bit tight! Of course the first one will wear it, but the material is so good I tried putting it on the cat too lol

reviews.name: 신****
reviews.content:
일단 너무 귀엽구요.
삑삑 바스락 터그놀이 노즈워크까지
다 되는 만능템이네요.
라떼 반응이 너무 좋아서 대만족입니다!
reviews.content_en: It's so cute first of all. Squeaky, crinkly tug play, nosework - it does it all. It's a must-have toy! Latte's reaction was so good, I'm totally satisfied!

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
산리오 콜라보 너무 귀여워서 미쳐버림.. 소재도 디테일도 너무 좋아요 텍마저 귀여워버림 >< 
살찐 4.2kg 뚱(포)메리안 L사이즈 딱 좋습니다 (가슴둘레 큰 편) 애착 공 장난감 하나만 가지고 는 강아진데 키티 터그 장난감 진짜 잘 가지고 놀아요 얼른 사세요 ~~~
reviews.content_en: The Sanrio collab is so cute I'm losing my mind.. The material and details are amazing too, even the tag is cute >< My chubby 4.2kg Pomeranian in size L fits perfectly (has a bigger chest). Even though he only had one attachment ball toy, he really loves playing with the Kitty tug toy. Buy it now ~~~

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
우리집 애기 강아지를 위한 선물로 구매했어요~~
너무 귀엽고 폭신하고 바시락 소리 삑삑 소리 노즈워크 기능까지 완벽해요!
끈이 있어서 물기 놀이에도 적합하고요~~
좋은 상품 감사합니다.
또 놀러올께요~^^
reviews.content_en: I bought this as a gift for my puppy at home~~ It's so cute and fluffy, and it's perfect with the crinkly sounds, squeaky sounds, and nosework functions! It even has a rope so it's great for tug play~~ Thank you for the great product. I'll be back~~^^

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
흰색에다가 끈에다가 바스락 삑삑이까지 모든게 다 들어있어서
너무너무 좋아해요~
reviews.content_en: With the white color, the rope, and the crinkle and squeaky sounds all included, I love it so much~

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 키티가 정말 귀엽고 생각보다 크기도 크고 부드러워 좋습니다. 아이가 터그놀이를 좋아하다 보니 구매한 지 4일 만에 끈과 리본이 거의 떨어질 정도가 되었지만 그만큼 잘 가지고 놀아서 내구성은 조금 아쉽지만 다시 구매 해야할 것 같습니다.
reviews.content_en: Kitty is really cute and bigger than expected, and soft too, which is nice. Since my pup loves tug play, just 4 days after I got it the rope and ribbon were almost falling off, but he played with it so much. The durability is a bit disappointing but I think I'll have to buy it again.

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
바잇미 콜라보 소식 들릴때부터 기대했는데
오픈하자마자 바로 구매했어요
일단 너무너무 귀여운 키티와 포차코
산리오는 제품은 가격대가 다 있는데,
바잇미에서 가격대가 너무 좋아요!
그래서 두가지 다 샀는데 다 너무 귀여워요
다른 콜라보제품도 짱짱귀여움
reviews.content_en: I've been looking forward to it since hearing about the BITE ME collab, and I bought it right when it opened. Kitty and Pochacco are super cute. Sanrio products all have different price points, but BITE ME has such great prices! So I bought both and they're both so cute. Other collab products are super adorable too.

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
바잇미 장난감이 질이 좋고 애기도 넘 좋아해서 제 마음에 드는 건 왕창 모으고 있어용 
로프 때문에 조금 무겁긴한데 바스락+삑삑이 다 들어있어서 만족!! 
로프 입에 물리고 목 털 빗기도 좋아여 ㅎ..

+ 아니 그리고 8천원대 장난감을 샀더니 7천원대에 판매중인 과자 증정중이네요..??🩷🩷🩷🩷
reviews.content_en: BITE ME toys are high quality and my pup loves them so much that I'm collecting all my favorites! The rope makes it a bit heavy but I'm satisfied because it has both crinkle and squeaky sounds!! The rope feels good in the mouth and helps brush neck fur too ㅎ.. + Wait, I bought a toy in the 8,000 won range and there's a free treat in the 7,000 won range?? 🩷🩷🩷🩷

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
엄청 좋아해요! 삑삑이도 되면서 터그까지 동시에 되는게 좋아요. 
큰애는 삑삑이 장난감은 안갖고 놀지만 터그는 엄청 좋아하고, 둘째는 삑삑이를 엄청 좋아하거든요. 두 애가 같이 가지고 놀 수 있는 장난감이라니.  특히 둘째가 2.4kg 작은아인데 가지고 놀기 좋은 적당한 사이즈에요!!
reviews.content_en: I love it so much! It's great that it squeaks and does tug play at the same time. My older one doesn't play with squeaky toys but loves tug, and my younger one loves squeaking. A toy both of them can play with together. Especially the younger one at 2.4kg, it's the perfect size to play with!!

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 너무너무 기여워요!!! 배송도 진짜 빠르고.... 야무지게 물고 뜯고 노는 저희집 댕아들입니다❤️❤️ 바스락소리랑 뾱뾱소리까지 강쥐들 좋아하는 요소가 다 들어가있어요 최애 장난감이 될 듯해요!!!!
reviews.content_en: So so cute!!! Shipping was really fast too.... My pup is a serious biter and destroyer ❤️❤️ It has all the elements dogs love - crinkle sounds and squeaky sounds. It's going to be his favorite toy!!!!

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 우리 강아지랑 놀이하려고 구매했는데 색감도 예쁘고 귀엽기도 한데 강아지가 좋아해서 너무너무 만족합니다ㅜㅠㅠ가성비도 좋아서 자주 구매해야겠어요!
reviews.content_en: I bought it to play with my dog and the colors are pretty and cute, plus my dog loves it so I'm very very satisfied ㅜㅠㅠ The value is good too so I'll have to buy often!

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
디자인이 일단 맘에 들고 배송이 빨라서 좋았는데
박스 포장은 너무 부실해서 받아보고 당황 스러울 정도 였어요 이렇게 박스에 택배용지까지만 테이프가 붙여있고 다른 곳엔 전혀 테이프 자체를 아예 안붙어 있어서 첨엔 되게 화났는데 용케 빠진 물품은 없더라고요 물건은 잘 받아서 사용 중이나 포장에 신경 좀 쓰셔야 할 거 같아요 박스포장 상태때뮨에 별을 더 적게 하려다가 제품엔 이상 없고 누락도 없어서 4개로 합니다
reviews.content_en: I liked the design and the shipping was fast, but the box packaging was so poor I was shocked when I received it. Only the box had tape on the shipping label and there was no tape anywhere else at all, so at first I was really angry, but surprisingly nothing was missing. The product was fine and I'm using it, but you should pay more attention to packaging. I was going to give fewer stars because of the box condition but since there were no issues with the product and nothing was missing, I'm giving it 4 stars.

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 포차코 ㅠㅠ 너무 귀여워요 🥹 그리고 강아지가 엄청 좋아합니다! 탄탄해서 오래 가지고 놀 수 있을 거 같아요 슬리퍼 장난감들 원래도 좋아하는데 이건 터그놀이도 할 수 있어서 마음에 들어용
reviews.content_en: Pochacco ㅠㅠ so cute 🥹 And my dog loves it so much! It seems sturdy so he can play with it for a long time. I originally liked slipper toys but this one is great because you can also do tug play

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
포차코랑 키티랑 둘중 하나 못고르겠어서 둘다 샀는데 둘다 너무 귀여워요ㅎㅎ
역시나 우리 강아지가 너무 좋아해요
둘중 뭐 먼저 가지고 놀래? 골라봐 하고 줬더니 포차코를 고르더라구요ㅋ 지금은 두개다 번갈아가면서 신나게 가지고 놀고 있답니다
reviews.content_en: I couldn't choose between Pochacco and Kitty so I got both and they're both so cute ㅎㅎ As expected my dog loves them both. I asked 'which one do you want to play with first? pick one' and he picked Pochacco lol Now he's excitedly playing with both alternating back and forth

reviews.name: 최****
reviews.content:
슬리퍼 장난감 엄청 좋아하는 댕댕이라 보자마자 사줬는데 역시 받자마자 최애 장난감으로 등극했습니다 ㅎㅎ
그러나 파괴왕답게 터그용 실은 하루만에 꼬인거 풀고 뜯어먹어서 잘라버리고 다시 바느질했어요 ㅠㅠ
터그끈 없이 슬리퍼만 따로 팔아주세요
reviews.content_en: My pup loves slipper toys so I got it right when I saw it and it instantly became his favorite toy ㅎㅎ But true to his destructive nature, he unwound and chewed up the tug rope in just one day so I cut it off and re-sewed it ㅠㅠ Please sell just the slipper without the tug rope

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
꺼내자마자 바로 가져가서 너무 잘 가지고놀아요!
디자인도 예쁜데 잡고 물기도 편해서 더 좋아하는 것 같네요☺️ 사주길 너무 잘했어여 뿌듯❤️
reviews.content_en: He grabbed it right away and plays with it so well! The design is pretty too and it's easier to hold and bite, so he seems to love it even more☺️ I'm so glad I got it, feeling proud❤️

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 퀄리티가 제일 좋고 탄탄해요!! 그리고 너무 귀엽고 아기가 너무 좋아합니다ㅎㅎ
reviews.content_en: The quality is the best and it's sturdy!! And it's so cute and my baby loves it so much ㅎㅎ

reviews.name: 박****
reviews.content:
키우는 강아지가 좋아하는 요소가 다 들어있어서
여러 장난감을 구매할 때 같이 구매했는데 제일 좋아하는
TOP2에 들어갑니다! 에너지 가득한 8갤 강아지인데 
튼튼하게 살아남아 있고 무엇보다 귀엽습니다💖
reviews.content_en: My dog loves all the elements that are included in this toy, so I bought it along with several other toys, and it's in his TOP 2 favorites! My 8-gallon energetic puppy has kept it in good condition and most importantly, it's adorable 💖

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
하루종일 저러고 있어요
물고 흔드는걸 너무 재미있어해요
컬러가 상큼해서 넘 예쁘고 가장 좋은 점은 굴러가지 않는 점~~
reviews.content_en: He's been doing this all day long. He loves biting and shaking it. The color is so fresh and pretty, and the best part is that it doesn't roll away~~

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content: 터그놀이에도 좋고 뒤에달린 끈을 엄청 좋아해요!
reviews.content_en: It's great for tug play and he really loves the rope attached to the back!

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 바잇미 장난감이 디자인이 아기자기 예쁘고 다른 장난감보다 그래도 좀 오래 가는 것 같아요 물론 쓰다보면 못쓰게 되는 순간이 오죠 아직 우리 강아지한테 주기 전인데 좋아했으면 좋겠어요
reviews.content_en: BITE ME toys have a cute, detailed design and they seem to last longer than other toys. Of course eventually there comes a time when they can't be used. I haven't given it to my dog yet but I hope he likes it

reviews.name: 박****
reviews.content: 안에 삑삑이 소리에 환장하고 안에 간식 넣어주면 간단노즈워크 할 수 있어서 좋아용
reviews.content_en: He goes crazy for the squeaky sound inside, and I can do simple nosework by putting treats inside, which is great~

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 내구성 짱짱이에요! 슬리퍼형태를 좋아해서 비슷한 모양의 장난감이 많은데 제일 내구성 좋아요!! 밧줄은 넘 딱딱하고 뻣뻣하긴 한데 슬리퍼모양 자체를 좋아하는거라 괜찮을거 같기두해요
reviews.content_en: The durability is amazing!! I like the slipper shape and there are a lot of similar toys but this one has the best durability!! The rope is too stiff and rigid, but since he likes the slipper shape itself, I think it'll be fine

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
아이가 너무 좋아해서 하도 물어뜯었었더니 실이 다 풀려서 새로 구매해줬어요 이갈이중인데 아주 딴딴해서 너무 좋아요^^ 슬리퍼안에 코박고 있으면 진짜 귀여워요 ㅋㅋ
포차코도 추가구매했어요
reviews.content_en: My pup loved it so much that he chewed and bit it so much the thread came loose, so I got a new one. He's teething and it's very sturdy so he loves it^^ It's so cute when he sticks his nose in the slipper lol I also bought Pochacco as an additional purchase

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 지난번 슬리퍼 버전보다 크기가 커져서 안에 간식 넣어서 주기도 편하고 강아지가 너무 좋아합니다.
reviews.content_en: This version is bigger than the previous slipper version so it's convenient to put treats inside and my dog loves it so much.

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 너무 귀엽고 딴딴해서 줄이 잘풀리지조 않아서 너무좋아요
reviews.content_en: So cute and sturdy, the rope doesn't come loose easily so I love it

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 되게 좋아해요 생각보다 삑삑소리는 잘 안나는데 오히려 그래서 더 좋아요!! 소리가 희귀하니까 더 오래 가지고 노는 느낌...??? 너무 예쁘구 맘에들어요 감사합니다
reviews.content_en: He really loves it. The squeaky sound doesn't come out as much as I thought, but actually that's better!! Since the sound is rare, it feels like he plays with it longer...??? It's so pretty and I love it. Thank you

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
겁이 많아 처음 보는건 경계하고 무서워하는데 헬로키티 이건 그런거 없이 너무 좋아하고 잘놀아요~^^ 삑삑,뽀시락소리나니 재밌나봐요
터그끈도 엄청 튼튼해서 만족합니다
reviews.content_en: He's usually scared of new things because he's timid, but with this Hello Kitty he's not like that at all and loves it and plays great~^^ The squeaky and crinkle sounds are fun apparently. And the tug rope is so sturdy I'm satisfied

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 아이가 너무 좋아해서 하도 물어뜯었었더니 실이 다 풀려서 새로 구매해줬어요 이갈이중인데 아주 딴딴해서 너무 좋아요^^ 슬리퍼안에 코박고 있으면 진짜 귀여워요 ㅋㅋ
reviews.content_en: My pup loved it so much that he chewed and bit it so much the thread came loose, so I got a new one. He's teething and it's very sturdy so he loves it^^ It's so cute when he sticks his nose in the slipper lol

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
너무 귀엽네요
터그놀이 신나게했는데 튼튼하네요
reviews.content_en: So cute. He played tug vigorously and it's sturdy~~

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 튼튼하고 귀여워요 .. 100개사고싶어요
reviews.content_en: It's sturdy and so cute.. I want to buy 100 of them

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 인형 튼튼하고 너무 귀여워요
reviews.content_en: The toy is durable and so adorable

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 배송도 빠르고 너무귀엽습니다
reviews.content_en: Fast shipping and it's super cute

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 너무 귀엽고 소리도 좋아요
reviews.content_en: It's so cute and the squeaky sound is great too

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 배송빠르고너무긔여워요
reviews.content_en: Fast shipping and so cute

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 배송빠르고너무긔여워요
reviews.content_en: Fast shipping and so cute

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 너무 귀여워요!! 생각보다 커서 깜짝 놀랐습니다. 저희집 강아지는 간식 넣어주는 거 말곤 관심이 없어서 아쉽지만 일단 예뻐서 만족합니다
reviews.content_en: It's so cute!! I was surprised it was bigger than I expected. My dog doesn't show much interest except when we put treats in it, which is a shame, but I'm satisfied because it looks great

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 친구네 강아지가 포차코 털색이랑 비슷해서 선물용으로 샀어요. 너무 맘에 들어해요. 강아지도 잘 가지고 놀아요. 삑삑이도 있고 터그도 되니 좋네요.
reviews.content_en: My friend's dog looks similar in color to Pochacco, so I bought it as a gift. She loves it! The dog plays with it well too. It has a squeaker and works as a tug toy, so it's perfect.
